labels.shortDescription: Name of the Data Manager feature in Settings, General.
labels.value: Data Manager

labels.shortDescription: What the Data Manager feature covers.
labels.value: Import, find, update and delete records in bulk: the Data Manager, Import, Find and Bulk Update tabs.

labels.shortDescription: Name of the Duplicate Matching feature in Settings, General.
labels.value: Duplicate Matching

labels.shortDescription: What the Duplicate Matching feature covers.
labels.value: The Duplicate Matching tab: suggests people and households that look like duplicates, for you to review and merge, and lets you choose what pairs them.

labels.shortDescription: Name of the Org Optimizer and Health Check feature.
labels.value: Org Optimizer and Health Check

labels.shortDescription: What the Org Optimizer and Health Check feature covers.
labels.value: Checks your org's setup and data and suggests fixes: the Data Hygiene tab and Health Check.

labels.shortDescription: Name of the Household upkeep feature in Settings, General.
labels.value: Household Upkeep

labels.shortDescription: What the Household upkeep feature covers.
labels.value: Creates, names and tidies households as people are added, changed and removed.

labels.shortDescription: Name of the Addresses feature in Settings, General.
labels.value: Addresses

labels.shortDescription: What the Addresses feature covers.
labels.value: Records address changes and keeps each household's primary address in step.

labels.shortDescription: Name of the Relationships feature in Settings, General.
labels.value: Relationships

labels.shortDescription: What the Relationships feature covers.
labels.value: Keeps both sides of a relationship between two people in step.

labels.shortDescription: Name of the Affiliations feature in Settings, General.
labels.value: Affiliations

labels.shortDescription: What the Affiliations feature covers.
labels.value: Keeps each person's primary affiliation with an organization current.

labels.shortDescription: Name of the Preferred email and phone feature in Settings, General.
labels.value: Preferred Email and Phone

labels.shortDescription: What the Preferred email and phone feature covers.
labels.value: Copies the email address and the phone number a person prefers into the standard Email and Phone fields.

labels.shortDescription: Warning above the feature list that turning one on is permanent.
labels.value: A feature can't be turned off once it is turned on. Turn on only what your organization will use.

labels.shortDescription: Button that turns a feature on, and the confirm button.
labels.value: Turn on

labels.shortDescription: State of a feature that is on.
labels.value: On

labels.shortDescription: State of a feature that is off.
labels.value: Off

labels.shortDescription: Title of the confirmation before a feature is turned on. {0} is its name.
labels.value: Turn on {0}?

labels.shortDescription: Body of the confirmation before a feature is turned on. {0} is its name.
labels.value: {0} will be turned on for everyone, with its tabs, settings and automations. It can't be turned off again.

labels.shortDescription: Added to the confirmation before Household Upkeep is turned on.
labels.value: It adds the Households tab. Create households with New Household on BarnCRM Home, not the standard New button.

labels.shortDescription: Cancel button of the confirmation before a feature is turned on.
labels.value: Cancel

labels.shortDescription: Message after a feature is turned on. {0} is its name.
labels.value: {0} is on. Its tabs appear for the right people within a few minutes.

labels.shortDescription: Error when the feature list cannot be loaded.
labels.value: The features could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

labels.shortDescription: Error when a feature key is not a feature in this org.
labels.value: That feature does not exist in this org.

labels.shortDescription: Error when a feature cannot be turned on.
labels.value: The feature could not be turned on. Try again, and check the Error Log if it keeps happening.
